summary: Call for papers status banner with a deadline and an optional consumer-provided action.
whenToUse: Communicating the current status of a call and its deadline.
whenNotToUse: Opening or closing a call, submitting proposals, or managing workflows.

props.name: status
props.description: Current status provided by the consumer.

props.name: action
props.description: Link or control provided by the consumer.

keyboard.action: Reaches any controls provided in the banner.

accessibility: The aside is labelled by the title; the status is conveyed with text, not color alone.
responsive: Content and action wrap when space is limited.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Do not derive the status from a local clock: pass the status decided by the application.
limits: No built-in CFP flow or automatic actions.
